generic_domain.justification: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is chosen as the most generic domain because it broadly encompasses concepts like Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), including both fully and partially observable variants. MDPs, whether they are in a fully observable or partially observable state, form the foundation of RL algorithms, making RL the umbrella under which these specific domains fall. Additionally, RL explores learning mechanisms such as exploration vs. exploitation, reward shaping, off-policy methods, and temporal difference learning approaches (e.g., Q-Learning, SARSA), thus it is not restrictive to only one type of problem or method.
